# Sources

This folder holds the provenance records for the source PDF documents ingested into the wiki. Each page corresponds to an annual report from the AFDK (Atrieflimren i Danmark) clinical database for the years 2023, 2024, and 2025, providing file metadata, cryptographic hashes, and direct links to the sequentially extracted document pages. These records ensure that every claim and entity in the wiki can be traced back to an exact page in the original reports.

## Pages

- [[afdk-2023|Source: AFDK_2023.pdf]] — Provenance record for the 121-page 2023 AFDK annual report, including its SHA-256 hash and links to 25 extracted document parts.
- [[afdk-2024|Source: AFDK_2024.pdf]] — Provenance record for the 113-page 2024 AFDK annual report, including its SHA-256 hash and links to 23 extracted document parts.
- [[afdk-2025|Source: AFDK_2025.pdf]] — Provenance record for the 98-page 2025 AFDK annual report, including its SHA-256 hash and links to 20 extracted document parts.
